global_enabled.description: Enable or disable CDP reporting globally. When disabled, cdpr starts but does not process any CDP packets.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the log file. Ensure the directory exists and is writable.

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the PID file. Used for service management (stop/restart).

update_interval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh internal state and flush pending outputs. Minimum 5 seconds.

max_neighbors.description: Maximum number of CDP neighbors to cache per interface. Older entries are evicted when exceeded.

listen_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (e.g., eth0, GigabitEthernet1/0/1) to monitor for CDP packets. If empty, all interfaces are monitored.

items.description: Interface name as recognized by the OS (e.g., 'eth0', 'en0')

plugins.description: List of output plugins to send CDP data to. Each plugin defines a destination (file, HTTP endpoint, InfluxDB, etc.).

enabled.description: Enable or disable this plugin. Disabled plugins are skipped during updates.

path.description: [file only] Path to the output file. Auto-created if directory exists.

format.description: [file only] Output format: 'json' or 'csv'. Defaults to 'json'.

rotation_max_size.description: [file only] Max file size (in bytes) before rotation. Set to 0 to disable rotation.

rotation_max_files.description: [file only] Number of rotated files to retain.

endpoint.description: [http only] Full HTTP(S) endpoint URL to POST CDP data to.

method.description: [http only] HTTP method to use: 'POST' or 'PUT'.

headers.description: [http only] Key–value pairs for HTTP headers (e.g., Authorization, Content-Type).

url.description: [influxdb only] InfluxDB server URL (including port, e.g., 'http://localhost:8086').

database.description: [influxdb only] InfluxDB database name to write to.

retention_policy.description: [influxdb only] Retention policy name. Defaults to 'autogen' if empty.

username.description: [influxdb only] Optional InfluxDB username. Leave empty for no auth.
